title: Services registry (inventory/services.json)
description: The only valid spellings of a `service:` key. Written by the Ops ServiceNow Operator after the human confirms each row. Every other agent reads it; none derive a service name from prose.

keys.description: Exactly one `service:<name>` per services[] row, in the same order.

candidates_rejected.description: Candidate strings the human said are not a service (a device, a test that belongs to another row, instance seed data). Kept so the next registry visit does not ask about them again.

name.description: Canonical spelling. This exact string follows `service:` on every key in the workspace.

aliases.description: Other strings that mean this service: ThousandEyes test names, the cmdb_ci_service name, ticket wording the human confirmed. Readers match aliases case-insensitively; they never add to this list.

owner.description: Team or person from cmdb_ci_service owned_by / support_group, or what the human said. Null when nobody said.

source_ref.description: Where the candidate came from: `servicenow:cmdb_ci_service/<sys_id>`, `thousandeyes:test/<testId>` (first test that named it), or `user` when the human typed it.
